symptoms: Athena SQL query fails on an Iceberg table that Spark reads without any problem
The failure starts days after a Glue runtime migration, with no change to the query
Dashboards and saved queries break while the ETL job keeps reporting success
likely_causes: The table was created or rewritten with 'format-version'='3'; Athena SQL does not read Iceberg format version 3
A Glue 5.1 or 6.0 job wrote the table and the format version was not pinned
diagnostic_steps: Read the table's format-version property from the Iceberg metadata
Check the declared consumer inventory for the table: sparkforge iceberg assess-upgrade <dir> --from 2 --to 3
Identify which job wrote the table and on which Glue version it ran
fixes: Pin 'format-version'='2' on the table property for cross-engine compatibility with Athena
Or keep v3 and move the Athena consumers to an engine that reads it, with the owners of those consumers agreeing to the change first
unsafe_fixes: Assuming the format version can be lowered in place after writes in v3: reverting is not trivially safe, and the move to v3 has to be treated as a one-way decision until the Iceberg version in use documents otherwise
verification: Run a smoke-test query in Athena over the table and confirm it returns rows
rollback: There is no in-place rollback of the format version. Recreate the table at 'format-version'='2' from the source data, then repoint the consumers
